description: Default remote blocklist feeds for `pkg-guard update-db` when no PKG_GUARD_FEED_URLS / --feed is given. Soft-fail if unreachable. Seed is always merged regardless.

feeds.name: pkg-guard-seed-mirror
feeds.note: Enable after this repository is published to GitHub (currently 404). Until then, update-db writes a seed-only cache, which is correct offline behavior.
